job.title: [Post] ... Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC). Strong QE Engagement ... #Hiring #QEEngagementLead #…

tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Backend Engineer | Java, Spring, SAP Commerce Cloud, API Integration & Quality Engineering
tailoring.summary: Backend engineer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and REST/OCC APIs, with proven success designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, and production support. Skilled in business analysis, user story creation and AI-assisted development, driving high-quality releases and seamless data flows ensuring customer satisfaction across international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud QE Engagement Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by InnovaIT Global’s focus on delivering top-tier Salesforce Commerce Cloud solutions and leading quality-engineering initiatives. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in e-commerce integration, API development and automated testing that aligns perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and built robust PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines and OCC REST services, enabling real-time product synchronization for global storefronts.

bullets.label: Quality Engineering
bullets.text: Created extensive JUnit test suites and automated CI/CD pipelines, guaranteeing high-quality releases and rapid defect detection.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories and functional specs, delivering solutions that met strict e-commerce compliance.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Led production troubleshooting and performance tuning, reducing latency and ensuring 99.9% uptime for mission-critical commerce sites.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: InnovaIT Global’s reputation for pioneering Salesforce Commerce Cloud implementations and its commitment to rigorous quality-engineering practices strongly resonates with my professional passion. I am eager to contribute my proven track record in complex e-commerce integrations, API development and automated testing to help the company deliver seamless, high-performing SFCC experiences for its clients, while growing within a forward-thinking, technology-driven environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud integration and QA expertise to drive high-quality SFCC solutions at InnovaIT Global.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce backend engineer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m excited about the QE Engagement Lead role at InnovaIT Global and would love to discuss how my API integration and quality engineering experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for QE Engagement Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the QE Engagement Lead position. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API integration, automated testing and production support. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
